infobox.usage: Unlocks the second story mobile trailer door across from the bus depot on Customs.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Portable bunkhouse key (Bunkhouse) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to one of the portable cabins that was being used as a bunkhouse, located somewhere in the Customs construction area.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Factory
sections.text: - On the ground under a jacket in the locked room next to the office on Factory. Factory emergency exit key needed. Due to it's low spawn chance, it's not the most reliable way to obtain this key.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Used on the second story portable cabin between the bus depot and the construction area on Customs.

sections.heading: Trading
sections.text: | Pack of Vita juice x1; Pack of Vita juice; +; Pack of milk x1; Pack of milk; +; Toilet paper x1; Toilet paper | → | Therapist; Therapist LL1 | → | Portable bunkhouse key; Portable bunkhouse key |
